about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Builder · Problem Solver · Automation Enthusiast
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Developer with experience building production-grade web applications across CRM systems, real-time platforms, and AI-integrated tools.
about.p2: My work focuses on connecting backend logic, clean frontend experiences, and intelligent automations — combining Go's performance, React's flexibility, and tools like n8n to automate what can be automated.
about.p3: Currently exploring the intersection of AI agents, workflow orchestration, and modern API ecosystems like Meta and Google Ads.
